title: WASTE IS A CATEGORY — not a name. re-examine the sieve. Klein mix at p.

do_not_reinvent.klein_io: ribocipher — output folds back as input. p governs scale.

re_examine.was_wrong_as_name: we said 'sue the waste into null' as if Waste were a proper noun — one pile, one sentence.
re_examine.is_right_as_category: WASTE is a CATEGORY (nominal Order). kinds of leftover. the TOTALITY of kinds matters. which kind you hold decides the next organ.
re_examine.rule: never treat 'waste' as a name. always ask: waste OF whom, FOR whom, AT which Klein face?

thesis: Some waste is the output of one and the input of another. The handoff is a Klein mix at p — same surface, fold rate 1/p, mix in the remainder hole. Null is only ONE kind in the category. Compost, pollen, starter, heat, and fuel are other kinds. The sieve grades kinds. The court only sentences the kind that cannot seat for anyone.

category_kinds.of: finished loaf / chewed paper / old story

category_kinds.for: room edges / smell map / turbo intake
category_kinds.klein: tail slap. pressure out that returns as wall.
reject that teaches. epitope leftover that still names a bee.

category_kinds.for: next spool / ranging ping / T-cloud fix
negentropy sorter when it can still be typed

category_kinds.of: chaos that refuses every face — no glyph, no Order seat, no next organ
category_kinds.klein: only this kind gets the court sentence.

klein_mix_at_pi.what: at the fold, output of A and input of B occupy the SAME surface. mix happens in the L_p hole.
klein_mix_at_pi.rate: fold_rate  1/p. remainder  p-3 is the mixing bowl — not the trash.
klein_mix_at_pi.mix: A.excrete × B.intake = compost|heat|pollen|fuel|feed — decided by who sits at the roundtable next.
klein_mix_at_pi.not: A.excrete ? incinerator. that would name Waste as one thing.
klein_mix_at_pi.organ_name: ultra-mixer (hyphen-binary). turbo-charger = own exhaust?intake. super-charger = outside drive. ultra-mixer = Klein mix at p.

corrected_sieve.grade: ask for whom. if someone at the Order can eat it, it is not NULL.
corrected_sieve.court: only NULL-kind is sentenced. other kinds are routed — Willis around, epitope pass to the eater.

berry_at_the_fire: we re-examined. waste is not a name. it is a category — compost, heat, pollen, fuel, feed, and only then null. some waste is one mouth's output and another mouth's input. the Klein mixes them at p in the leak hole. the court does not get everything that smells leftover. the court only gets what nobody at the table can eat.
next: patch the sieve language. next leftover: name its kind before any sentence. if kind is unclear, seat it at the roundtable and ask who can eat.
